A person who designs and builds machines, roads or bridges.
Bahasa Indonesia: insinyur
Example: The engineer drew a plan for a new bridge over the river.
cards.say: engineer. A person who designs and builds machines, roads or bridges. The engineer drew a plan for a new bridge over the river.

cards.back:
A person who designs buildings.
Bahasa Indonesia: arsitek
Example: An architect showed us a model of the new library.
cards.say: architect. A person who designs buildings. An architect showed us a model of the new library.

cards.back:
A person who writes news for papers or television.
Bahasa Indonesia: wartawan
Example: The journalist interviewed the mayor about the new park.
cards.say: journalist. A person who writes news for papers or television. The journalist interviewed the mayor about the new park.

cards.back:
A person who flies an aircraft.
Bahasa Indonesia: pilot
Example: The pilot told the passengers that the weather was fine.
cards.say: pilot. A person who flies an aircraft. The pilot told the passengers that the weather was fine.

cards.back:
A doctor who does operations.
Bahasa Indonesia: dokter bedah
Example: The surgeon washed her hands carefully before the operation.
cards.say: surgeon. A doctor who does operations. The surgeon washed her hands carefully before the operation.

cards.back:
A person who prepares and sells medicines.
Bahasa Indonesia: apoteker
Example: The pharmacist explained how often I should take the medicine.
cards.say: pharmacist. A person who prepares and sells medicines. The pharmacist explained how often I should take the medicine.

cards.back:
A person who fits and repairs electrical wiring.
Bahasa Indonesia: tukang listrik
Example: The electrician fixed the broken light in our hallway.
cards.say: electrician. A person who fits and repairs electrical wiring. The electrician fixed the broken light in our hallway.

cards.back:
A person who repairs vehicles and machines.
Bahasa Indonesia: montir
Example: The mechanic checked the engine and changed the old oil.
cards.say: mechanic. A person who repairs vehicles and machines. The mechanic checked the engine and changed the old oil.

cards.back:
A person who studies the world through careful experiments.
Bahasa Indonesia: ilmuwan
Example: The scientist grew plants under different colours of light.
cards.say: scientist. A person who studies the world through careful experiments. The scientist grew plants under different colours of light.

cards.back:
A person who cooks food in a restaurant.
Bahasa Indonesia: koki
Example: The chef added fresh herbs to the soup before serving it.
cards.say: chef. A person who cooks food in a restaurant. The chef added fresh herbs to the soup before serving it.

cards.back:
A person whose job is to put out fires and rescue people.
Bahasa Indonesia: petugas pemadam kebakaran
Example: The firefighter climbed a long ladder to reach the roof.
cards.say: firefighter. A person whose job is to put out fires and rescue people. The firefighter climbed a long ladder to reach the roof.

cards.back:
A doctor for animals, often called a vet.
Bahasa Indonesia: dokter hewan
Example: The veterinarian gave our puppy an injection and a biscuit.
cards.say: veterinarian. A doctor for animals, often called a vet. The veterinarian gave our puppy an injection and a biscuit.

cards.back:
A person who looks after your teeth.
Bahasa Indonesia: dokter gigi
Example: The dentist showed me how to brush my back teeth.
cards.say: dentist. A person who looks after your teeth. The dentist showed me how to brush my back teeth.

cards.back:
A person who keeps and checks records of money.
Bahasa Indonesia: akuntan
Example: The accountant helped the shop owner count the monthly profit.
cards.say: accountant. A person who keeps and checks records of money. The accountant helped the shop owner count the monthly profit.

cards.back:
A person who changes spoken words into another language.
Bahasa Indonesia: juru bahasa, penerjemah lisan
Example: An interpreter helped the visitors talk with the local farmers.
cards.say: interpreter. A person who changes spoken words into another language. An interpreter helped the visitors talk with the local farmers.

A person trained to travel in space.
Bahasa Indonesia: astronaut

cards.say: astronaut. A person trained to travel in space. The astronaut floated inside the space station and waved at the camera.

A person who looks after the books in a library.
Bahasa Indonesia: pustakawan

cards.say: librarian. A person who looks after the books in a library. The librarian helped me find a book about volcanoes.

A person who takes pictures for a job.

cards.say: photographer. A person who takes pictures for a job. The photographer asked everyone to stand close together and smile.

A person who gives advice about the law.

cards.back:
A person who makes things from wood.
Bahasa Indonesia: tukang kayu
Example: The carpenter measured the plank twice before he sawed it.

A person who starts and runs a business.
